description: Write a text file to the project: a note, a CSV table, a write-up. A new path is created, folders included. from_results takes a get_results query and writes its whole table as CSV, uncapped. To change a file, pass expected: the sha256 read_project_file gave; if it changed since, the write is refused, so read it again. overwrite: true replaces it unread, only when told to. Never write keys: every member reads Files.
name: write_project_file
